# ENV006: Docker daemon unavailable

<!-- Code generated by cmd/rulegen from the builtin registry. DO NOT EDIT. -->

Component: docker. Severity: error.

Collector prerequisites: docker.

The local default Docker engine is stopped, inaccessible, or uses another socket.

Evidence required: A trusted Docker CLI and a recognized failure to connect to the default local engine.

Manual steps:

- Start the local Docker engine and check permission to its default socket.

Verify with `envdoctor diagnose --rule ENV006`.

Limitations:

- The endpoint is /var/run/docker.sock or the Windows docker_engine pipe. Selected TCP/SSH contexts are metadata only.
- CLI absence, denied inspection, malformed output and unknown failures do not prove an outage.
- M2 snapshots without probeStatus preserve their documented unavailable-daemon interpretation.

No command is executed by this rule. Evidence comes only from the snapshot. Failed prerequisite collectors disable the rule. Positive, negative and edge fixtures cover Windows, Linux and macOS; platform exclusions are listed above.

Documentation: <https://github.com/shellghostt/envdoctor/blob/main/docs/rules/ENV006.md>.
